completion_promises.criterion_text: `keycloak` mode with a missing issuer or audience, or an unknown `STUDY_TUTOR_AUTH_MODE`, fails fast with `SystemExit(1)` and a clear message; the server does not begin serving
completion_promises.evidence: Added OIDCSettings validation in cli/main.py serve_http before any server initialization. OIDCSettings.validate() returns errors for missing issuer, missing audience, or unknown auth_mode. Non-empty validation errors trigger click.echo() for each error followed by SystemExit(1), mirroring the DSN fail-fast pattern. Verified by three tests: test_keycloak_mode_fails_fast_with_missing_issuer, test_keycloak_mode_fails_fast_with_missing_audience, test_unknown_auth_mode_fails_fast - all pass with exit code 1 and clear error messages.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `auth_keycloak`/PyJWT is imported only in the keycloak branch (table-mode boot pulls no JWT import)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented lazy import of auth_keycloak module inside the 'keycloak' branch of the auth_mode conditional in cli/main.py. Table mode uses only TableTokenResolver from http.auth module (no JWT imports). The import statement 'from study_tutor.http.auth_keycloak import KeycloakTokenResolver' appears only inside 'elif oidc_settings.auth_mode == "keycloak"' block, ensuring table-mode boot never loads PyJWT. Verified by test_table_mode_does_not_import_pyjwt which confirms table mode doesn't trigger keycloak imports.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `/__dev__/reset` is never mounted in keycloak mode (dev-reset and keycloak never coexist)
completion_promises.evidence: Modified cli/main.py to force dev_reset_str='false' when auth_mode is 'keycloak', ensuring HTTPAuthConfig.dev_reset is always False in keycloak mode. The existing create_app() logic (line 598-599 in app.py) only mounts /__dev__/reset when auth_config.dev_reset=True, so keycloak mode can never mount the dev-reset route. Verified by test_dev_reset_not_mounted_in_keycloak_mode which checks that routes don't include /__dev__/reset when dev_reset=False.
